angel291592-intent-router-intent-router.description: Converges an underspecified request into an IntentSpec: looks up what sources answer, asks only what they cannot, halts instead of guessing, checks delivery against the spec. Use when a request to implement, add, change, fix or configure leaves a decision open — scope, approach, failure behaviour, what done means — contradicts itself, reads two ways, or rests on a premise sources rule out. Silent on a fully stated request its sources do not contradict; not for explaining existing state.
